name: Announce length caps
description: Announce wire-length and App Data caps (spec 05-routing 9.2, R-05-068): the announce MUST NOT exceed 193 bytes and App Data MUST NOT exceed 100 bytes (254-byte signed link body minus 4-byte link header, 8-byte signer id, 48-byte link signature, and 1-byte routing dispatch). Wires are dispatch-stripped announce bytes; parse must accept exactly-at-cap and reject one-past-cap.

length_caps.name: min_length_accepted
length_caps.description: 93-byte announce with no App Data is accepted

length_caps.name: max_length_accepted
length_caps.description: 193-byte announce with 100 bytes of App Data is accepted

length_caps.name: over_wire_cap_rejected
length_caps.description: 194-byte announce (101 bytes of App Data) exceeds both the 193-byte wire cap and the 100-byte App Data cap and is rejected
